title: Fanconi Anemia: Matrix Remodeling and Oral Carcinogenesis
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Fanconi anemia (FA) increases the risk of oral potentially malignant disorders (OPMDs) and oral squamous cell carcinoma; however, the stromal alterations associated with FA-related oral lesions remain poorly defined. We investigated whether extracellular ...
